items.other_label: restructuring = combined 'Restructuring/Transaction (and Litigation) costs' row as published (transaction not split out, so transaction=null); inventory_pa = 'One-time PPA' (non-cash GE Transportation inventory step-up); other_op = non-cash accounting 'Policy Harmonization' (GE Transportation accounting-policy harmonization; also adjusts net sales/GP); nonop = merger-related interest/financing costs in the 'Interest & Other Exp' column of the restructuring/transaction row; discrete_tax = 'Tax on Transaction Costs' (non-deductible transaction costs).

ngaap.guidance: 2019 guidance (updated Jul-30-2019): GAAP sales ~$8.3bn; GAAP op income ~$800m; GAAP diluted EPS $2.20-$2.30 (GAAP NI $390-410m); EBITDA ~$1.3bn; adjusted sales ~$8.3bn, adjusted EBITDA ~$1.6bn, adjusted op income ~$1.2bn, adjusted EPS $4.10-$4.20 (adjusted NI $725-740m); adjusted op margin ~14%; ETR ~24%; net synergies ~$20m; GAAP CFO raised to ~$900m; recurring PPA ~ $0.80/sh after tax not added back.
ngaap.notes: 2019 'adjusted' definition (as originally reported): excludes GE Transportation merger costs - transaction & restructuring (and, from Q3, litigation) costs, one-time non-cash purchase price accounting (inventory step-up) charges, non-cash accounting policy harmonization, related merger financing interest and tax on non-deductible transaction costs. Recurring PPA amortization was NOT added back in 2019. EBITDA (2019 definition) = income from operations + depreciation + amortization (other income excluded, so ebitda_other=null); ebitda_dda = depreciation + amortization columns summed. From Q1-20 Wabtec redefined adjusted results (adds back all non-cash intangible amortization and FX losses; drops policy harmonization and one-time PPA in adjusted sales/GP) and EBITDA (= op income + other income + D&A). Recast in Q2-20 release under 2020 definition: Q2-19 adjusted op income 387.2, adjusted EPS $1.33. Recurring PPA $56m pre-tax ($0.22/sh) not added back as originally reported.
